# Christian Curator

> Christian Curator is a daily-updated evangelical content curation site. Each morning we publish a digest of the best evangelical writing from across the web, organized around the questions evangelicals are actually asking. Deep-dive topic pages present multiple evangelical perspectives on theological and cultural debates in a fair, biblically-grounded, educational way.

- Site: https://www.christiancurator.com
- Audience: Evangelical Protestants, pastors, seminary students, curious readers
- Approach: Fair presentation of multiple evangelical positions; neutral, educational tone
- Publisher: Christian Curator Editorial

## Deep Dive Topics

### Core Theology

- [The Atonement](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/atonement/): What exactly did Jesus' death accomplish — and how does it actually save us?
- [Justification by Faith](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/justification-by-faith/): Is justification a declaration of righteousness, a process of becoming righteous, or something else?
- [Biblical Inerrancy](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/biblical-inerrancy/): Is the Bible without error in everything it affirms, or only in matters of faith and practice?
- [Baptism](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/baptism/): Should we baptize infants or only those who profess faith — and does it matter?
- [The Lord's Supper](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/lords-supper/): Is Christ truly present in the bread and cup, and if so, how?
- [Heaven, Hell & Eternity](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/heaven-hell-eternity/): Is hell a place of eternal conscious torment, or does God eventually destroy the lost?
- [Creation & Evolution](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/creation-evolution/): Did God create the universe in six literal days, or is Genesis compatible with modern science?
- [Suffering & Providence](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/suffering-and-providence/): Does God ordain suffering for our good, or does he merely permit it?
- [Gender & Biblical Anthropology](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/gender-and-biblical-anthropology/): What does Scripture teach about what it means to be male and female?
- [Apologetics](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/apologetics/): Should Christians defend the faith through reason and evidence, or simply proclaim the gospel?
- [Predestination & Free Will](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/predestination-free-will/): Is salvation ultimately determined by God's sovereign choice or the human will's free response — and what are the stakes of getting this question right?
- [The Holy Spirit & Spiritual Gifts](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/holy-spirit-spiritual-gifts/): Do miraculous spiritual gifts like tongues and prophecy continue today, or did they cease with the apostolic age — and how does the answer shape Christian life and worship?
- [The Trinity](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/the-trinity/): What does it mean that God is one being in three persons — and why does Trinitarian theology matter for prayer, salvation, and everyday Christian life?
- [Eschatology & End Times](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/eschatology/): Will Christ return before, during, or after a thousand-year reign — and does your eschatology change how you live now?
- [Israel & Prophecy](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/israel-and-prophecy/): Does the modern state of Israel fulfill biblical prophecy — and what do the Old Testament land promises mean for Christians today?
- [Christology](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/christology/): Is Jesus fully God and fully human at the same time — and why does the answer matter for salvation, prayer, and everything else?
- [Covenant Theology](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/covenant-theology/): Is the Bible best read as one unified covenant story, or as a sequence of distinct dispensations — and what's at stake in getting this right?

### Church Life

- [Complementarianism & Egalitarianism](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/complementarianism-egalitarianism/): Should women serve as pastors and elders, or are those roles reserved for men?
- [Church Discipline](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/church-discipline/): When and how should a church remove a member — and what does restoration look like?
- [Worship & Liturgy](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/worship-and-liturgy/): Should evangelical worship be free-form and contemporary, or anchored in historic liturgical forms?
- [The Local Church](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/local-church/): Is belonging to a local church optional for Christians, or essential to spiritual health?
- [Missions & Evangelism](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/missions-and-evangelism/): What is the church's primary mission — gospel proclamation, or social transformation?
- [Church History](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/church-history/): How should evangelical churches relate to the wisdom — and failures — of their historical ancestors?
- [Church Membership](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/membership/): Is formal church membership a biblical requirement or an optional formality?
- [Church Planting](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/church-planting/): Is planting new churches the best strategy for reaching new communities?
- [Preaching](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/preaching/): What makes preaching faithful — and is expository preaching the only legitimate approach?
- [Pastoral Accountability](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/church-accountability/): How should evangelical churches build structures that protect the vulnerable, hold leaders accountable, and prevent the abuse of power?
- [Spiritual Abuse & Toxic Churches](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/spiritual-abuse/): How do churches recognize and respond to spiritual abuse — and why does it so often go unaddressed?
- [Small Groups](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/small-groups/): Are small groups the engine of discipleship in the local church — or a poor substitute for the deep community Christians actually need?
- [The Pastor's Role](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/pastoral-ministry/): Is the pastor primarily a preacher, a shepherd, a CEO — and how does the answer shape the health of a church?
- [Church Governance](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/church-governance/): Should churches be governed by elders, congregations, or bishops — and does polity really matter for church health?

### Spiritual Formation

- [Prayer](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/prayer/): Does prayer change what God does, or does it primarily change us?
- [Discipleship](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/discipleship/): What does it actually mean to make disciples — and are most churches doing it?
- [Sanctification](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/sanctification/): Is growing in holiness primarily God's work in us, or does it require rigorous human effort?
- [Spiritual Disciplines](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/spiritual-disciplines/): Are the spiritual disciplines a path to growth — or a path to legalism?
- [Spiritual Warfare](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/spiritual-warfare/): How active is demonic activity in the everyday lives of Christians?
- [Fasting](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/fasting/): Is fasting a neglected discipline the church must recover, or a practice easily misunderstood?
- [Anxiety & Fear](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/anxiety-and-fear/): Is anxiety primarily a spiritual failure, a medical condition, or both?
- [Mental Health & Faith](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/mental-health/): How should Christians think about depression and mental illness — as primarily spiritual, medical, or both?
- [Deconstruction & Faith](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/faith-deconstruction/): When Christians begin questioning their beliefs, what does faithful deconstruction look like — and how should churches and pastors respond?
- [Contemplative Prayer](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/contemplative-prayer/): Are contemplative practices like centering prayer and lectio divina a rich retrieval of Christian tradition — or a dangerous import of mystical techniques incompatible with evangelical theology?
- [Grief & Lament](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/grief-and-lament/): Is lament a failure of faith — or does Scripture call suffering Christians to honest, anguished prayer?
- [Forgiveness](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/forgiveness/): Is Christian forgiveness unconditional — or must it require repentance from the offender?
- [Christian Friendship & Community](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/christian-friendship/): Why are deep friendships so rare in evangelical churches — and what does Scripture teach about the community we were made for?
- [Singleness](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/singleness/): Is singleness a lesser life than marriage — or does the New Testament present it as an equally valid, even uniquely powerful, calling?
- [Biblical Literacy](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/biblical-literacy/): Why do so many Christians read the Bible so little — and what would change if the church actually knew Scripture?
- [Pornography & Sexual Purity](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/pornography/): Is pornography primarily a spiritual problem, a neurological addiction, or both — and what does genuine freedom actually look like?
- [Death & Dying](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/death-and-dying/): How should Christians prepare for death — and does the church have anything distinctive to offer a culture that avoids it?

### Culture & Society

- [Politics & the Church](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/politics-and-the-church/): Should evangelical Christians seek political power, or hold it at arm's length?
- [Racial Reconciliation](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/racial-reconciliation/): Is racial reconciliation best pursued through structural change, individual repentance, or gospel proclamation?
- [Technology & the Christian Life](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/technology/): How should Christians navigate a world increasingly shaped by technology and social media?
- [Technology & Discipleship](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/technology-and-discipleship/): How do smartphones and social media form us spiritually — and what should Christians do about it?
- [Marriage & Family](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/marriage-and-family/): What does a distinctively Christian vision of marriage and family look like in a post-Christian culture?
- [Christian Parenting](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/christian-parenting/): How do Christian parents faithfully pass on faith to the next generation?
- [Christian Ethics](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/christian-ethics/): How do Christians navigate complex moral questions the Bible does not directly address?
- [Vocation & Work](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/vocation-and-work/): Is all honest work sacred, or does ministry hold a higher calling?
- [The Future of Evangelicalism](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/evangelicalism/): Is the evangelical movement fracturing — and if so, what should come next?
- [Christian Nationalism](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/christian-nationalism/): What is Christian nationalism, why is it attracting evangelical support, and how does it differ from faithful Christian political engagement?
- [Biblical Sexuality](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/biblical-sexuality/): What does Scripture teach about same-sex attraction, marriage, and sexual identity — and how should evangelical churches care for LGBTQ+ neighbors and members?
- [Artificial Intelligence & the Church](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/ai-and-the-church/): How should Christians think about AI's impact on ministry, human dignity, creative work, and what it means to be made in the image of God?
- [Biblical Justice & the Social Gospel](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/biblical-justice/): What is the evangelical responsibility toward the poor and oppressed — and how do we distinguish biblical justice from a social gospel that eclipses the gospel itself?
- [The Prosperity Gospel](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/prosperity-gospel/): Does God promise health and wealth to the faithful — or is the prosperity gospel a dangerous distortion of Christ?
- [Religious Liberty](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/religious-liberty/): Is religious liberty under genuine threat — and how should Christians respond when conscience conflicts with the law?
- [Progressive Christianity](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/progressive-christianity/): Is progressive Christianity a reform of the faith — or has it progressed so far it has become a different religion altogether?
- [Christian Education](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/christian-education/): Should Christian parents put their children in public schools, Christian schools, or homeschool them — and is there a biblical answer?
- [Abortion & the Pro-Life Movement](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/abortion/): What does the pro-life movement owe to women after Roe — and is the church doing enough?
- [Addiction & Recovery](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/addiction-and-recovery/): Is addiction a sin, a disease, or both — and what does the church offer that secular recovery programs cannot?
- [Creation Care](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/creation-care/): Is caring for the environment a Christian responsibility — or a distraction from the gospel?
- [Christian Masculinity](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/christian-masculinity/): What does it actually mean to be a man in the church today — and is evangelical culture making men better or worse?
- [Stewardship & Generosity](https://www.christiancurator.com/topics/stewardship-and-generosity/): Is tithing a law, a floor, or a ceiling — and what does radical gospel generosity actually demand of Christians?

## Daily Content

- [Today's Digest](https://www.christiancurator.com/digest/): Today's curated roundup of the best evangelical writing from across the web
- [Archive](https://www.christiancurator.com/archive/): Past daily digests, searchable by date
- [Voices](https://www.christiancurator.com/voices/): Authors and publications featured across our curation

## About

Every deep-dive topic page includes: a TL;DR answer to the central debate question, key questions evangelicals ask, a presentation of multiple evangelical positions, a synthesis, an FAQ, and the ten most recent curated articles on the topic. Pages are updated as new articles are curated. All content is generated and maintained by Christian Curator Editorial.
